narrative.headline: Compare Shinkansen fares and constraints before booking
narrative.value_prop: Read-only dated adult fares, discount deadlines and baggage checks from smartEX and linked JR sources. Plan with Japanese station names and precise JST dates, then book through the official site.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public planning commands need no login. Exact trains and seat inventory are available through the canonical member booking handoff.

quickstart.comment: Check installation without a network call
Compare a public dated adult quote

narrative.when_to_use: Use for read-only Tokaido, Sanyo and Kyushu Shinkansen route, fare, product, baggage and booking-window planning. Use the official booking site for exact seats.
anti_triggers: Real bookings, payments, accounts and reservation mutation
Guaranteed availability or complete dated train inventory
Child fare estimates unsupported by the public navigator
